name: helios-llm-orchestrator
description: Local-first MCP multi-LLM orchestrator with task decomposition and benchmark-guided OpenRouter routing.

scripts.check: node --check mcp/mcp-server.mjs && node --check scripts/scan-secrets.mjs && node --check scripts/run-python.mjs && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m py_compile agent/server.py agent/benchmark_registry.py scripts/refresh-benchmarks.py
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test tests/mcp-server.test.mjs && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
